WORKSPACE PREFERENCES

Settings

Keep the workspace calm and useful.

APPEARANCE

Theme

Dark is the default. Light mode uses a warm paper/parchment tone instead of pure white.

REMINDERS

Browser notifications

Enable browser notifications for local task reminders. Google Calendar can be used for calendar events.

DATA

Local workspace

NEXA syncs your workspace so your data persists securely across sessions. Clearing the workspace removes your saved tasks, notes, proofs, brainstorms and focus history.

SHORTCUTS

Quick controls

N = new task · P = pen · T = text · E = eraser · V = select · Ctrl/Cmd + Z = undo
